view.name: Claude Meter
config.title: Context Meter for Claude Code
config.showCost: Show the equivalent API cost (approximate; with Pro/Max it is not what you pay).
config.contextWindow: Context window in tokens. 0 = automatic, using Claude Code's rules (1M by default on Opus 4.7+, Sonnet 5+, Haiku 5.5 and Fable; Opus/Sonnet 4.6 only with [1m]; honors CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT).
config.warningPercent: Context % at which the status bar turns yellow.
config.errorPercent: Context % at which the status bar turns red.
config.statusBar: What to show in the status bar. The Claude Meter view, below the Claude Code chat, shows everything in Detailed mode.
config.statusBar.none: Nothing (everything is in the Claude Meter view)
config.showBlock: Show usage of the current 5-hour block (estimated from all Claude Code on this computer).
config.blockWarnRatio: Fraction of your largest 5-hour block at which the indicator turns yellow (red when it goes over).
config.saveToDisk: Save the session and 5-hour block history (history.json and blocks.json, in the extension's own storage) to keep it when Claude Code deletes old transcripts. When off, the extension writes nothing to disk: it only reads the transcripts and keeps new data in memory. Existing files are not deleted.
config.pollMs: How often, in milliseconds, the active transcript is read again.
config.priceOverrides: Custom prices per model (USD per million): { "opus-5-5": [input, output, cacheWrite5m, cacheWrite1h, cacheRead] }.
config.viewMode: How much the Claude Meter view (below the Claude Code chat) shows. You can also switch it with the Simple / Detailed buttons at the top of the view.
config.viewMode.simple: Simple: context and usage limits only
config.contextTips: Show tips in the Claude Meter view when the context grows (when to use /compact or start a new chat).
